data.name: iFinD 同花顺实时行情 (THS Real-time Quotation)
data.description: Query real-time quotation data for securities in the 同花顺 (THS) iFinD database, providing real-time market data for financial products including stocks, funds, bonds, and futures, such as real-time prices, trading volumes, price changes, bid/ask quotes, etc. Supports querying various real-time indicators including latest price, price change, trading volume, turnover ratio, market value, and five-level bid/ask quotes. It does not have US stock market quotes. CFFEX data queries are not supported. Latency is about 3s.

params.name: codes
params.description: [MANDATORY PARAMETER NAME: codes] You MUST use the plural 'codes'. The singular 'code' is STRICTLY PROHIBITED. This parameter must be a single string containing one or more codes separated by commas , e.g., '300033.SZ,600030.SH', DO NOT use JSON lists or arrays.

params.name: indicators
params.description: Indicator list, multiple indicators separated by commas. Options: 'common', 'all', or custom list: af_backward, amount, avgPrice, buyVolume, change, changeRatio, committee, commission_diff, downLimit, high, lastest_price, latest, latestAmount, latestVolume, low, mv, open, pb, pbr_lf, pe_ttm, preClose, riseDayCount, sellVolume, suspensionFlag, swing, thscode, time, totalCapital, totalShares, tradeDate, tradeStatus, tradeTime, turnoverRatio, upperLimit, vol_ratio, volume. Default is 'all'.

data.provider_description: 同花顺 (THS) iFinD data provider, offering financial data for Chinese and international markets including stocks, securities, funds, bonds, futures, etc. Supports company announcements, intelligent stock screening, industry analysis, market trend prediction, and more, helping users conduct comprehensive financial data analysis and investment decisions.

data.name: iFinD Money Flow (Stock / Sector / Market)
data.description: Retrieve multi-granularity fund flow data from THS iFinD for A-share market. scope=stock: individual stock fund flow over a date range — close price, change pct, main net inflow/ratio, super-large/large/medium/small active buy amounts, DDE net vol, 5/10/20-day DDE, turnover (13 indicators, date_sequence endpoint). scope=sector: sector index fund flow on a single date — sector name/category/type, change pct, main/super-large/large net inflow, rise/fall/total stock counts (10 indicators, basic_data_service endpoint). scope=market: market index fund flow over a date range — main/super-large/large/medium/small net inflow, total turnover, inflow rate (7 indicators, date_sequence endpoint).

params.name: scope
params.description: 'stock' = individual stock, 'sector' = sector/industry index, 'market' = market index

params.name: codes
params.description: Comma-separated security codes (max 50). stock: e.g. '600519.SH,000858.SZ'; sector: e.g. '801010.SL,801020.SL' (Shenwan industry indices); market: e.g. '000985.CSI' (CSI All Share Index)

params.name: startdate
params.description: Start date for stock/market scope, or single query date for sector scope. Formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYYMMDD, YYYY/MM/DD.

params.name: enddate
params.description: End date. Required for stock and market scopes; ignored for sector scope.
